## Read

#### ★★☆ Numerical Linear Algebra

Trefethen & Bau · 1997 · *SIAM* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Numerical%20Linear%20Algebra%22)

- **Why:** The best book on *why* numerical linear algebra algorithms work.
- **Read:** Lectures 20–23 (LU, pivoting, stability).

#### ★★★ Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms (2nd ed.)

Nicholas Higham · 2002 · *SIAM* · book · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Accuracy%20and%20Stability%20of%20Numerical%20Algorithms%20%282nd%20ed.%29%22)

- **Why:** The reference on rounding-error analysis, including the growth factor in partial pivoting.
- **Read:** Ch. 9 (LU factorization).

#### ★★☆ The cache performance and optimizations of blocked algorithms

Lam, Rothberg & Wolf · 1991 · *ASPLOS* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22The%20cache%20performance%20and%20optimizations%20of%20blocked%20algorithms%22)

- **Why:** The paper that quantified cache blocking: how tile size interacts with cache conflicts.
- **Read:** All of it, before your tile-size sweep.

#### ★★★ Anatomy of high-performance matrix multiplication

Goto & van de Geijn · 2008 · *ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Anatomy%20of%20high-performance%20matrix%20multiplication%22)

- **Why:** What `mat_mul_fast` becomes when taken all the way: the GotoBLAS design.
- **Read:** All of it.

#### ★★☆ Roofline: an insightful visual performance model for multicore architectures

Williams, Waterman & Patterson · 2009 · *Communications of the ACM* · paper · [Scholar ↗](https://scholar.google.com/scholar?q=%22Roofline%3A%20an%20insightful%20visual%20performance%20model%20for%20multicore%20architectures%22)

- **Why:** Place your matmul on a roofline and see how far from peak it is.
- **Read:** All of it.
